task_title: perf(core): reuse per-map FOV pass state and fuse visibility writes

plan_review.notes: Adversarial red-team of the FOV reuse design. Verdict risky, 5 concerns (2 blocking). Alternatives argued: (1) stateless subset only, (2) origin-tile-keyed persistent seam memo, (3) purpose-built direct-array shadowcaster. All 5 resolved: reentrancy guard moved ahead of cache-hit/state-rebuild; bench oracle decontaminated (blank bitmaps + symmetric revision bump) since warmup ran the live fovSystem; FNV hash replaced with byte-exact lockstep comparison; coverage gap closed with a differential suite vs a verbatim reference (corners/edges, negative and past-edge origins, seam pillars, subFactor 1/2/4/8, mid-life subFactor change, transparency mutation at fixed origin, shared FloorMap); existing isTransparent-spy tests rewritten onto clearVisibility. Alternative (1) answered empirically with a committed 3-way ablation.
